1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless side‑scroll runner
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = 200;
9: 
10:   // Game state
11:   let speed = 2; // pixels per frame
12:   let score = 0;
13:   let gameOver = false;
14: 
15:   // Player
16:   const player = {
17:     x: 50,
18:     y: H - 20,
19:     w: 10,
20:     h: 10,
21:     vy: 0,
22:     jumpStrength: -6,
23:     onGround: true,
24:     draw() {
25:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
26:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
27:     },
28:     update() {
29:       this.vy += 0.3; // gravity
30:       this.y += this.vy;
31:       if (this.y + this.h >= H) {
32:         this.y = H - this.h;
33:         this.vy = 0;
34:         this.onGround = true;
35:       } else {
36:         this.onGround = false;
37:       }
38:     },
39:     jump() {
40:       if (this.onGround) {
41:         this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
42:         this.onGround = false;
43:       }
44:     }
45:   };
46: 
47:   // Obstacles – simple vertical blocks of varying height
48:   const obstacles = [];
49:   function spawnObstacle() {
50:     const gap = 120 + Math.random() * 80; // distance from previous obstacle
51:     const lastX = obstacles.length ? obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x : W;
52:     const x = Math.max(lastX + gap, W);
53:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
54:     obstacles.push({ x, y: H - h, w: 10, h });
55:   }
56: 
57:   // Input handling
58:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
59:     if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump();
60:   });
61:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => player.jump());
62: 
63:   // Main loop
64:   function loop() {
65:     if (gameOver) return;
66:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
67: 
68:     // Update player
69:     player.update();
70:     player.draw();
71: 
72:     // Update obstacles
73:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
74:       const ob = obstacles[i];
75:       ob.x -= speed;
76:       ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
77:       ctx.fillRect(ob.x, ob.y, ob.w, ob.h);
78: 
79:       // Collision
80:       if (
81:         player.x < ob.x + ob.w &&
82:         player.x + player.w > ob.x &&
83:         player.y < ob.y + ob.h &&
84:         player.y + player.h > ob.y
85:       ) {
86:         gameOver = true;
87:       }
88: 
89:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
90:       if (ob.x + ob.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
91:     }
92: 
93:     // Spawn new obstacles periodically
94:     if (obstacles.length === 0 || obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x < W - 200) {
95:       spawnObstacle();
96:     }
97: 
98:     // Increase speed gradually
99:     speed += 0.0005;
100:     score += speed;
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
102:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
103:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
104: 
105:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
106:     else {
107:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
108:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
109:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
110:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
111:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   // Start
116:   spawnObstacle();
117:   loop();
118: })();
